page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9ae.xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs utilizing the x86_64 architecture, specifically driven by an AMD EPYC 9T95 processor running at a clock speed of 2.25 GHz. The instance is configured with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This instance does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage options. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The lack of integrated local storage and GPUs represents a clear tradeoff, positioning this instance strictly for non-graphical, network-dependent workloads.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without the resource contention typical of shared-core instances. The 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio makes it a resource-dense option for compute-bound tasks that do not require large memory footprints. Suitable workloads include web serving, batch processing, microservices, and lightweight compilation tasks.
